test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Kiara was born in India but she went to ______ university in ______ United Kingdom.
solution:
The correct answer is '**a; the**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The article "**a**" is used before the word "university" because "university" starts with a consonant sound.
 
• The article "**the**" is used before "United Kingdom" because it is a specific name of a country that includes the word "United."
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **3** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Kiara was born in India but she went to **a**__ university in __**the**__ United Kingdom."*
